titleEn: A hallmark, a prong, and filigree
canDoYue: 你識問印記、爪托、銠同金絲。
canDoEn: Ask about a hallmark, a gold prong, rhodium, and filigree.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Could you check the hallmark on this gold prong before we leave the shop at noon?
dialogue.glossYue: 中午離開舖頭之前，可唔可以檢查呢個金爪托上面嘅印記？
dialogue.say: Could you check the hallmark on this gold prong before we leave the shop at noon?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: I can check that hallmark on site, and the gold prong is included before noon.
dialogue.glossYue: 我可以現場檢查嗰個印記，中午之前金爪托包咗。
dialogue.say: I can check that hallmark on site, and the gold prong is included before noon.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Would a soft rhodium finish keep the filigree bright if I wear it each Friday?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果我每個星期五都戴，軟銠面可唔可以保持金絲光亮？
dialogue.say: Would a soft rhodium finish keep the filigree bright if I wear it each Friday?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: A soft rhodium finish will keep the filigree bright, and Friday noon is fine here.
dialogue.glossYue: 軟銠面可以保持金絲光亮，星期五中午可以喺度做。
dialogue.say: A soft rhodium finish will keep the filigree bright, and Friday noon is fine here.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Is the filigree quote lower if I take that rhodium pair home this Friday night?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果我星期五晚上帶嗰對銠貨返去，金絲報價會唔會低啲？
dialogue.say: Is the filigree quote lower if I take that rhodium pair home this Friday night?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: The filigree quote is two thousand dollars, and Friday night is fine for the pair.
dialogue.glossYue: 金絲報價二千蚊，星期五晚上可以取嗰對。
dialogue.say: The filigree quote is two thousand dollars, and Friday night is fine for the pair.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Please set that hallmark note aside until I decide on the gold prong later.
dialogue.glossYue: 請先放低嗰張印記字條，我遲啲再決定金爪托。
dialogue.say: Please set that hallmark note aside until I decide on the gold prong later.

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: I will hold that hallmark note until noon, and the gold prong can wait here.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會留住嗰張印記字條到中午，金爪托可以喺度等。
dialogue.say: I will hold that hallmark note until noon, and the gold prong can wait here.
